Anatomy

Parcel size

Order
  1. 1.dr-mapviewThe live map, a background image on a <div> with role="img" and its own label, so a screen reader meets one object. It fills the column under the nav bar, 373 × 375.2 at the 375 frame.
  2. 2.dr-sheet--dockThe sheet that does not float. It has no scrim, no aria-modal and no exit, because there is nothing behind it to go back to. It keeps the grip and --shadow-raised. Measured 340.8 tall.
  3. 3.dr-offersA fieldset of radios named by the sheet's title: one tab stop, with the arrow keys moving inside it. Three offers on every service.
  4. 4.dr-offerA radio label: 56 × 44 well, name 17/600, meta 13/400, price. It measures 341 × 60 at radius 12, with rows 8 apart. An unchosen row is a --card card: name and price 14.37:1, meta 5.95:1.
  5. 5.dr-offer__price17/600 with tabular figures. It is the size of a title, because the price is what is being chosen.
  6. 6.dr-btn--primaryOrder, 341 × 44.

When to use

This is what Find on the finder opens: the live map, with a sheet docked to the bottom carrying the offers to choose between. It stands on listings-map, listings-map-aerial and listings-map-inspection. An offer is a radio wearing a card. The whole row is the target, and the checked state belongs to the control, not to an attribute a script has to keep true.

The chosen row's green has three recorded departures, all the designer's decision. The fill is 1.52:1 against the grey rows, under the 3:1 of WCAG 1.4.11; the radio keeps the state programmatic (4.1.2). There is no checkmark, which HIG · Lists and tables would draw. And the screen has two green controls: by pixel Order is 4.77%, the chosen row 5.94–6.01%, and the frame 10.71–10.78% against the ~5% ceiling. The --ink focus ring stands outside the green at 15.99:1 on the drawer.

Copy is a fact per row: the size or deliverable in the name, availability and arrival time in the meta (4 available · arrives in 6 min), and the price on the row, before the tap (voice P3). The action is Order.

Sources: DESIGN.md § The search home (Results on the map, A choice row) · inventory.md § 1 Results on the map · microcopy.md § listings-map · voice.md P3 · ui/kit.html § The map screen

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Parcel size

Order

One choice from a few offers, with the price on every row and one Order under them. The first offer is checked when the screen opens.

Don’t

Up to 2 kg

An offer drawn as a link that leaves the screen. A value the user compares and then confirms is a radio row in .dr-offers. A choice card is for navigation, a fork between routes. To pick a value from a field row without a map, use the sheet picker.
